package: THT 2x5 P2.54 vertical box header (shrouded, keyed)

*.source: XFCN drawing BH254V-xxP rev A1: pin '0.64*0.64', P.C.B hole layout 'Ø1.02±0.05'

compliance.source: XFCN drawing BH254V-xxP rev A1 (RoHS mark), read 2026-10-31

sources: XFCN 2.54mm Box Header Connectors, drawing BH254V-xxP, rev A1 (2024.05.24, drawn 2024.07.19), one sheet – LCSC product data of C492442, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/ba7420b494e9cd4a616e90e79ef1dbc1.pdf?productCode=C492442, read 2026-10-31
i_max_a 3.0: specifications 1 'Current rating: 3A' (per contact – the drawing does not say; the whole header carries more where several contacts share a rail)

r_contact_ohm 0.02: specifications 5 'Contact resistance: 20mΩ Max.'; insulation resistance 1000 MΩ min.; withstanding voltage 600 V AC for one minute (a test voltage, not a working voltage – v_max_v left out)
pitch_mm 2.54, 2 rows of 5: ordering code BH254V-10P (2x05: A 10.16, B 20.35 mm); pin 0.64 mm square, holes Ø1.02 ± 0.05 mm on a 2.54 mm grid

pins: EasyEDA symbol and footprint of C492442 (edakit part import 2026-10-31): pad 1 square, odd pads in the row next to the key slot, even pads in the other row (IDC numbering); the drawing's triangle marks the pin-1 end on the key-slot side
LCSC/JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 27 227 pcs; C492446 is the SMD variant BH254VS-10P
notes: Shrouded 2 × 5 box header, 2.54 mm: the key slot in the middle of one long side lets a keyed IDC socket seat one way only. As Eurorack 10-pin power entry (block eurorack-power): pins 1/2 −12 V (red stripe), 3–8 GND, 9/10 +12 V. Library draft.

checked: specifications: current rating 3 A, -40 … +105 °C, contact resistance 20 mΩ max., 600 V AC / minute withstanding
2x05: 2 rows × 5 pins, pitch 2.54 mm, pin 0.64 mm square, hole Ø1.02 ± 0.05 mm, body 20.35 × 8.9 mm
EasyEDA footprint IDC-TH_10P-P2.54-V-R2-C5-S2.54: 10 plated holes on 2.54 mm, pad 1 square in the row at the key slot, key-slot outline and pin-1 triangle on the silkscreen
open: the footprint's holes are 1.1 mm against the drawing's 1.02 ± 0.05 mm
the rating does not say whether 3 A is per contact; no working voltage (only the 600 V AC test voltage)

open.text: pin 1 at the key slot and the triangle against the footprint's silkscreen – a reversed header turns the key and with it the ribbon
